title: Chapter 302
text:
Continuous explosions rang out from the spot where the spaceship had crashed. Huang Jian rubbed his hands together and breathed out hot air, deeply worried.

"It sounds like a battle. Who is he fighting with?" Huang Jian was confused. Could it be that Han Xiao was fighting with aliens in the middle of nowhere?

Just thinking about it made him feel that this world was crazy.

After waiting for a while, the sound suddenly disappeared. Huang Jian was worried. Although he had heard about Han Xiao's strong battle record, his opponent was an alien.

"If something happens to him, no one will give me orders. Should I continue to wait for him …?"

Just as he was in a dilemma, a figure flew up from the direction where the spaceship had crashed and quickly approached. It was Han Xiao. He landed beside the helicopter with a strong gust of wind. The mechanical suit was full of scars, and some parts of the armor were even cracked, exposing the internal wires that were crackling with sparks.

"That's great. You're fine." Huang Jian heaved a sigh of relief. Suddenly, he saw that Han Xiao had brought along a creature that he had never seen before. It had light golden skin, and its facial features were quite far apart. Its hands and feet were also locked by mechanical shackles that were electrified. It was Kerlodd. At this time, his face was swollen, and he was naked.

"Outside …" Huang Jian was tongue-tied. He pointed at Kerlodd and was too shocked to say anything.

"Alien. It took me a lot of effort to catch him."

Han Xiao grabbed Kerlodd by his hair and stuffed him into the cabin. The Godora man was angry, but his mouth was sealed. He could only struggle like a dead fish.

Huang Jian was shocked. He knew that Han Xiao was strong, but he didn't expect him to be so strong that he could even catch an alien.

"Fly the helicopter quickly. This is close to the Raylan border. Their people will be here soon," Han Xiao said.

Huang Jian hurriedly started the helicopter, and it quickly flew away.

On the plane, Han Xiao took off his mechanical suit and checked the damage. He only had about twenty percent of his armor left. The Godoran Investigator's equipment was very advanced, but in the end, Han Xiao unleashed a barrage of attacks. Kerlodd was like a delicate girl being pressed to the ground, unable to retaliate at all. He could only passively endure the barrage of attacks.

He destroyed the investigator's combat suit and seized the golden ball, ensuring that Kerlodd would not be able to touch any weapons. He only left behind a translator so that it would be easier for him to fool … ah, communicate with him.

He got the communicator and a Godora man. The completion rate was higher than expected.

I can still get a lot of benefits from him. I'll deal with him when I get back. Han Xiao was thinking about a new plan.

Huang Jian was very curious about the alien. He turned around and asked, "Your Excellency, does he bite people?"

As an emissary of a higher civilization, Kerlodd was seen as a barbaric beast by a native. He was furious, but his hands and feet were tied, so he could only protest by banging his head on the steel plate.

"I don't think so …" Han Xiao touched his chin and said, "But seeing how fierce he is, he might have a hobby like that."

Kerlodd kept banging his head on the steel plate.

Huang Jian curiously asked, "Can he eat it?"

Han Xiao squeezed the Godora man's arm and said, "His skin is smooth, and his meat is tough. Are you interested?"

Huang Jian hesitated for a while and nodded. "I haven't eaten an alien before."

Bang bang bang!

He banged his head on the steel plate even more frequently.

Backward! Barbaric! Kerlodd roared in his mind. Then, a trace of fear appeared in his heart.

These natives don't really want to eat me, do they?

Huang Jian was very excited. He asked all kinds of questions. He wanted to know how Han Xiao knew that aliens would come to the Blue Star and why he wanted to capture them. Kerlodd also wanted to know these questions.

First, the spaceship malfunctioned for no reason and forced a landing. Then, he met this strong man in a mechanical suit who claimed to be an emissary. Then, he suddenly attacked him and tied him up.

Kerlodd was furious when he remembered that the analysis module's evaluation of the Blue Star was that it was not dangerous. How long had it been since the database was updated? How could this not be dangerous?

"Who is he? Why did he capture me? How did he know that I was forced to land here?" Kerlodd was very confused. Han Xiao did not say anything.

"Is he a male or a female?" Huang Jian was curious.

Han Xiao was annoyed. "Look for yourself."

Huang Jian opened his eyes wide and looked for a while. He was very surprised. "I thought that the alien would be very big since it was so big …"

Bang!

Kerlodd could not stand the humiliation anymore. He used all his strength to hit the steel plate and knocked himself unconscious.

…

Ten minutes after the helicopter left, Raylan's troops finally arrived. They found the spaceship and were shocked. They immediately sealed the scene.

"This is an alien spaceship!"

"The orders from above said that this is the spaceship of our alien friend, Godora! They are here to help us investigate the Inhumans! "

"The mountain has collapsed. This is not a normal landing. The spaceship has crashed! Check if there are any survivors! "

"Report, there are no corpses in the spaceship. There are traces of battle around!"

Raylan's troops searched for clues and observed the battlefield. They came to a conclusion.

"There were two people fighting. Both of them were superhumans. One of them used a weapon that we do not know. These marks on the trees look like they were melted by lasers. There are also marks of chopping. The cut is very smooth. Even the internal structure of the trees is smoothed out. It is not a normal cold weapon. These marks of battle contain a high radiation level. This should be the Godora people."

"The other party used gunpowder weapons. The metal composition of the shells is similar to ours. There are also some armor fragments on the ground. This should be the strong person from our planet. We need to match the database. Judging from the destruction of the battlefield, this person is definitely at the top of the Blue Star. There are only a few strong people in this area. We will be able to identify the target soon."

"The final result of the battle should be that the Godora people were captured."

"Did you find anything else?"

At this time, one of the researchers found that a piece of the spaceship armor had been opened. Inside was the internal parts of the spaceship. He curiously looked around and used his flashlight. Suddenly, he saw something special and said, "There seems to be liquid inside the spaceship."

"Liquid?"

Everyone gathered around. Under the strong light, they found a pile of metal and pipes covered in a thick black liquid.

"What is this?"

"Probably engine oil," someone said with uncertainty.

This time, the officer suddenly said, "Orders from above. Secretly transport the spaceship back to the country!"

Godora's spaceship had crashed. This was a rare opportunity for the Blue Star government. Raylan decided to research spaceship technology. Since their civilization was behind, they had to grab hold of any opportunity to develop. Only by taking risks would they have the hope of making a comeback.

Of course, Raylan did not dare to anger the Godora civilization. They would inform the Godora civilization about this, but they had to delay for a period of time. They had to pretend that they did not know or that they were searching for the missing Godora people. Either way, they had plenty of excuses.

Raylan took this matter very seriously and decided to keep it a secret to prevent the news from leaking. They wanted to monopolize the spaceship.

As for the missing Godora people, Raylan decided to search for them secretly.
